claims.text: Corticosteroids, topical or systemic, should be started in all pts w confirmed DRESS
claims.quote: Corticosteroids, whether topical (TCSs) or systemic (SCSs), should be initiated in all patients with confirmed DRESS due to the inflammatory nature of the illness.
claims.locator: EAACI position paper on drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS) in children (Pediatr Allergy Immunol, 2025)

claims.text: Supportive care plus topical corticosteroids = effective option for mild DRESS (adult and pediatric retrospective data)
claims.quote: Findings from retrospective studies in both adults and children suggest that supportive care combined with TCSs is an effective treatment option for patients with mild DRESS
claims.locator: EAACI position paper on drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS) in children (Pediatr Allergy Immunol, 2025)
